sections.title: anupallavi
lyrics: thOm thOm thOm thaka thillAna - thagum thagum thagum - jaNu thaka dhi ka
jham thamitha dheem dheem tha nom nom tha tha - ka dhimi jaNu thaka dhimi kita thadhi gi Na thom

sa ma ga mA tha ki ta thi thillAna jaNu tha - sa ma ga sa dhi mi tha - A nan dham

sections.title: charanam
lyrics: koti soorya prakAsha nija bhaktha - koti jana hRdhaya nivAsa sivakumari
thEdi vandhEn aruLai nAdi vandhEn unnai - pAdi vandhEn shivanE - eedillA padham thArAi
madhyamakAlam - thaku thiku yEna natam Adiya pAdhamE - mukha malar thani nagai thigazh unnai nathanE
kanda nadai - thAm thAm tha oru pAdham thaka dheem tha thanai ondRi
thisra nadai - thAm tha dheem tha kAlai thookki - thOm tha nam tha yEndrum aadum
